title: Men's 5000m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's 5000m (3000m–2 Miles–5km) event ranking as of 3 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. Includes associated road and short-track performances. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten, not the complete athlete population. Source places 5–7 share 1338 points; the site displays equal-value ties.
